A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

LPA, a lipid metabolite, mediates the pathophysiology of psoriasis by binding with LPAR5 in keratinocytes, leading to the activation of PKD1 and ROCK, which in turn activates NF kB, resulting in the up regulation of inflammatory cytokines.
